name: Digital operational resilience testing programme
description: DORA Arts. 24–25: every ICT system supporting a critical or important function gets at least one appropriate test a year (vulnerability assessment, scan, penetration test, scenario-based or BCP/DR test), and threat-led penetration testing runs on a three-year cycle. Coverage is the share of systems with a completed test.

plan.title: {year} Digital Operational Resilience Testing Programme
plan.objective: By {period_end_long}, every ICT system supporting a critical or important function has had at least one appropriate, risk-based test in the year by an independent tester, every issue found is classified and remediated or accepted, and the threat-led penetration testing cycle is on track.
plan.decisions_requested:
Approve the {year} testing programme: the systems in scope, the test planned for each and its quarter.
Approve the test types and frequency by system tier, and the testers' independence.
Note the threat-led penetration testing cycle: the last test, the next due date and this year's preparation.

strata.name: Systems supporting critical or important functions
strata.definition: ICT systems and applications supporting a critical or important function: at least one appropriate test a year (DORA Art. 24(6))

strata.name: TLPT scope
strata.definition: Critical or important functions in the scope of threat-led penetration testing, at least every three years (DORA Art. 26(1)). An item's last-tested date is its last TLPT.

attributes.requirement: The test type and scope are appropriate to the system's criticality and threat exposure.
attributes.procedure: Compare the test's scope and type with the system's tier, internet exposure and the programme's test type matrix.
attributes.evidence_requested: Test scope and rules of engagement
attributes.pass_criteria: The test covers the system's components in scope, with a type the matrix sets for its tier.

attributes.requirement: The test is performed by an independent tester, internal or external.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the tester's assignment and confirm they do not build or run the system.
attributes.pass_criteria: The tester is independent of the system; for an internal tester, conflicts of interest are managed.

attributes.requirement: The test was executed as scoped and reported.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the test report against the scope.
attributes.pass_criteria: A dated report covers the whole scope, or records what was not tested and why.

attributes.requirement: Every issue the test found is classified and logged.
attributes.procedure: Trace the report's issues to the vulnerability or findings register.
attributes.pass_criteria: Every issue is logged with a severity, an owner and a due date.

attributes.requirement: Critical and high issues are remediated, or accepted, within the agreed time, and the fixes verified.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the remediation evidence or the retest of each critical and high issue.
attributes.pass_criteria: Each critical or high issue is fixed and verified, or formally accepted, within its due date.

attributes.requirement: The TLPT follows the TLPT requirements: scope validated by the authority, threat intelligence and red team phases, closure with a summary report, remediation plan and attestation.
attributes.procedure: Inspect each phase's documentation and the authority's correspondence.
attributes.pass_criteria: Every phase is documented and the attestation is obtained.

raci.activity: Approve the programme and the test type matrix
Maintain the systems in scope and their CIF link
Classify the issues and agree remediation

cadence.content: Tests in flight, scope changes, blocking issues
Coverage of systems in scope, issues by severity, overdue remediation, TLPT status
Annual results, the TLPT cycle, and the next year's programme

escalations.trigger: A critical issue not remediated or accepted by its due date
escalations.escalate_to: CISO, then the ICT Risk Committee

escalations.trigger: A system in scope without a completed test at the end of Q3

regulatory_basis.requirement: Establish, maintain and review a sound and comprehensive digital operational resilience testing programme as part of the ICT risk management framework.
regulatory_basis.how: This plan is the programme for the year, approved by the ICT Risk Committee and reported to the management body.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Follow a risk-based approach to testing, and have tests undertaken by independent parties, internal or external.
regulatory_basis.how: The test type matrix sets the type by tier and exposure; attribute RT-02 checks each tester's independence.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Establish procedures to prioritise, classify and remedy the issues revealed by the tests, and validate that they are fully addressed.
regulatory_basis.how: Attributes RT-04 and RT-05; issues become findings in Audit Findings with owners and due dates.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Conduct appropriate tests on all ICT systems and applications supporting critical or important functions at least yearly.
regulatory_basis.how: Every system in scope is in a wave and gets a test record; coverage is the share with a test signed off by QA.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Provide for a full range of appropriate tests: vulnerability assessments and scans, network security assessments, scenario-based tests, penetration testing and the others the article lists.
regulatory_basis.how: Each test record carries its type from the programme's list.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Test the ICT business continuity plans and the ICT response and recovery plans at least yearly.
regulatory_basis.how: BCP / DR tests are a test type of the programme for the systems in scope.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Carry out threat-led penetration testing at least every three years, where the entity is identified for it.
regulatory_basis.how: The TLPT stratum runs on a three-year cycle from each item's last TLPT; the T steps plan a TLPT year.
